🔥🇲🇽 ANAM CUSTOMS OFFICIAL ARRESTED AT MATAMOROS BRIDGE FOR ORGANIZED CRIME TIES

Carlos Eugenio Benítez Orta, 46, a customs official at Mexico's National Customs Agency (ANAM), was detained today at the Matamoros International Bridge — "Puerta México." Charges: organized crime. The arrest was a joint Mexico-US coordinated operation; the intelligence came through Mexico's Centro Nacional de Inteligencia and was executed by SSPC, the Criminal Investigation Agency of the FGR, and ANAM itself.

Official statement: "tras acciones de coordinación entre autoridades de México y Estados Unidos, dicho funcionario fue asegurado." Benítez Orta is now in Altiplano maximum-security federal prison.

ANAM was created in 2021 precisely to professionalize the border and pull customs out of corrupt SAT hands. The system is cleaning its own house — no gringo military intervention required.

Source: Contralínea

🇲🇽📚 SHEINBAUM HANDS OUT BECA RITA CETINA TO 57,519 KIDS IN COLIMA

President Sheinbaum opened the Rita Cetina scholarship rollout in Villa de Álvarez, Colima today: 57,519 primary-school students get a debit card with 1,900 pesos every two months for uniforms and school supplies. Colima now has 125,485 Bienestar scholarship recipients in 2026 — over 650 million pesos invested in that state alone.

"En el inicio del ciclo escolar en agosto, las familias necesitan comprar uniformes y útiles — eso es la beca Rita Cetina," Sheinbaum told the crowd. Universal, no income test, no conditions. Compare to DC, where Congress is cutting student loans and lunch programs while it ramps up the ICE budget by $38 billion.

Source: La Jornada

🚨🇲🇽 NUEVO LEÓN ANTI-CORRUPTION COMMISSION APPROVES POLITICAL TRIAL AGAINST GOV. SAMUEL GARCÍA

The Anti-Corruption Commission of Nuevo León's Congress voted 6-in-favor today (PRI, PAN + 1 Morena deputy) to formally proceed with a political trial against MC governor Samuel García over an alleged scheme that triangulated nearly 1 billion pesos in public resources to law firms tied to his family. García has been summoned to appear at 4 PM on June 23 before the state legislature; he gets 15 business days to respond.

The same governor who spent 2023 trying to ride a state plane to a federal presidential candidacy, who Wall Street called the "anti-AMLO," is now answering for nearly a billion pesos routed to relatives' firms. Accountability finally caught up.

Source: La Jornada

🇲🇽✊ The President stated her age publicly: 63, turning 64. In Villa de Álvarez, Colima, Sheinbaum addressed the stigma around women disclosing their age and said the expectation unfairly targets women. — Sheinbaum at the Beca Rita Cetina event, Villa de Álvarez, Colima The event was named for Rita Cetina, the 19th-century Yucatecan feminist educator who founded the first secular school for girls in Mexico. The scholarship she inspired covers school supplies and uniforms for primary students.

🇲🇽🎨 "Public school is the best." Sheinbaum at the Beca Rita Cetina rollout in Villa de Álvarez, Colima. She credited the teachers in the public system for the quality of Mexican education. — Sheinbaum at the Beca Rita Cetina event, Villa de Álvarez, Colima The scholarship covers school supplies and uniforms for primary students. Secondary students get an ongoing monthly stipend. High school students receive the "Benito Juárez" scholarship. Coverage is universal — no merit gate.

🇲🇽✊ "Every child should have a scholarship — every one." In Villa de Álvarez, Colima, Sheinbaum announced 57,519 additional primary students added to the Rita Cetina scholarship for the state, with investment exceeding 650 million pesos. Grades, she said, should not decide who gets help. — Sheinbaum at the Beca Rita Cetina event, Villa de Álvarez, Colima Rita Cetina was a 19th-century Yucatecan feminist educator who founded the first secular school for girls in Mexico. The scholarship in her name now covers school supplies and uniforms for primary students nationwide.
